verdict.rationale: Finix documents recurring billing via Subscriptions and configurable payout schedules in its test environment, which are forms of recurring financial jobs, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose workflow/automation scheduler, cron-like triggers, or AI-agent-driven recurring task orchestration beyond these payment-specific features. Missing for 10: generic recurring workflow/automation engine, scheduling API beyond payouts/subscriptions, AI-agent orchestration of recurring tasks.
